lines: Before we begin the movement,
make sure both feet are resting on the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and look straight ahead.
The aim is to move slowly,
without pulling your neck forward.
If the chair feels unstable,
stop and choose a firmer seat.
We will repeat the same sequence twice,
then compare how the two sides feel.
